items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever hear Freddie Caput? No, I haven't. No, I haven't. From New Orleans. No, I haven't.

ctx.x: Joe Oliver? Yes, I remember him in the early days. I think he used to play Yanmobili. He used to come over here and play for the next school. That's been quite a while now. Oh, yes, a long time. Yeah, I'm going way back. I remember quite a few out of the audience, but I just can't recall them now because I'm not prepared.
Did you ever hear Freddie Caput? No, I haven't. No, I haven't. From New Orleans. No, I haven't.
We're just about out of tape here. Is there any other thing that you can think of you'd like to tell about or think we should know?
